mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) can potentiate cholinergic effects of donepezil and increase syncope/bradycardia risk; donepezil may cause bradycardia which compounds loop diuretic effects on cardiac conduction.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, assess for syncope/falls, consider potassium-sparing agent or supplementation, monitor heart rate and blood pressure; ensure adequate hydration.
